coordinator_review: Compared issuer notices and the current public English objectives with the new guides, inventory and original scenarios. Checked all cited source associations and resolved the fresh-context findings. Accepted objective snapshots match the targeted official collector.

independent_ai_review.type: fresh-context read-only AI beta-intake diff and evidence review
independent_ai_review.scope: Two complete draft guides, accepted objectives and official status, source and candidate registration, health and inventory associations, and AZ-401/MO-410/SC-730/AB-210 decisions in the source report. Existing AZ-401 and AB-210 guide text was outside the two-guide substantive review.

checks.official_scope: Pass. Six AB-330 process domains and four GH-700 domains match issuer headings and weights. The October 15 and October 13 page-update dates are accurately differentiated from skills-effective dates.
checks.objective_coverage: Pass for these introductory beta guides. Revised cases span the six processes and all four GH domains. Intercompany parties, inbound/outbound evidence, discrepancy counting, vendor collaboration, model/session comparison, scoped agent profiles, skills and MCP, and failed-run follow-up give readers concrete practice. Neither text is an exhaustive objective-by-objective implementation manual.
checks.material_claim_support: Pass for the intake. Checked issuer URLs and current product references, including dates and usage bounds on Procurement Agent, ATP/CTP, order status, intercompany account direction, workflow writes and account-dependent GitHub execution. GitHub project visibility was changed to a reader-access exercise. Both full-path durations are corroborated by exact Microsoft Learn path catalog records.
checks.exam_contract_integrity: Pass. AB-330 booking, 700 score and no available assessment match its exam-specific Microsoft page. GH-700 creator/sponsor and Microsoft delivery are explicit. Sponsor public app data says English, 90 minutes and no prerequisites; Microsoft gives 100 minutes, 700 and delayed beta scoring. No GH practice assessment or scheduling completion is claimed.
checks.technical_coherence: Pass. A partially received order may remain open; 80 received less 10 held gives at most 70 eligible under the scenario assumptions. GH exercises require reconciliation of claimed completion with the actual PR and issue records, plus a defined reviewer and documented stop or retry.
checks.volatility_lifecycle: Pass. Both launch forecasts remain forecasts, and the retirement, conflicting timings and product preview carry visible qualification. AB-210 title, availability bulletin and exam-specific scoring conflict remain visible.
checks.lab_safety_feasibility: Pass. Paper-based alternatives and fictional records enable practice without paid or operational accounts. GH resources identify prerequisites and approval boundaries.
checks.readiness: Pass. The cases ask learners to produce decision evidence, cross-check conflicting evidence and explain who can act.
checks.review_evidence: Pass for scoped draft review. No prior source-validation review for either guide, neither promoted. 18 and 13 external URLs each have exact accepted source, supported-exam association and individual tracked OK response. Some pre-existing health records date to October. Their health is transport evidence only.
checks.duplication_contamination: Pass. Independently worded exam-specific scenarios and correctly distinguished supplement. No recalled questions, vendor-material copying in original guide prose, unrelated technical content or unsupported assessment endorsement identified.

dispositions.reason: A revised six-process scenario grid teaches concrete missing inventory, supply and customer/supplier decisions.
New handoff grid covers model/session comparison, agent profiles, skill/MCP use, escalation and failed-run monitoring.
Report opening counts scheduling-enabled, beta-titled Microsoft credentials and explicitly records the provisional AB-210 inventory label.
Final GH-700 guide treats checking reader permissions as a practical exercise; the Projects overview supports the views to which it is now attached.

inventory_disposition.AB-330: Microsoft-issued schedulable beta, January 2027 GA forecast. Exam MB-330 and its separate credential retire February 1, 2027.
inventory_disposition.GH-700: GitHub-maintained Microsoft-delivered beta, December 2026 GA forecast. The Microsoft card explicitly identifies the certification and delayed scoring. The prior flagged AB-730 practice route is not recommended.
inventory_disposition.AZ-401: Existing published guide linked. Additional expert award route correctly recorded as GH-300 or AZ-104, plus AZ-401. December 2026 GA forecast.
inventory_disposition.MO-410: Correctly announced only. Named as coming soon among Associate prerequisites on the MOS Expert requirements page; Certiport lists Outlook 2019. No objective or scheduling inference.
inventory_disposition.SC-730: Correctly excluded from open offerings. Microsoft explicitly withdrew the release even though the card title still says beta.
inventory_disposition.AB-210: Correctly separate and provisional. July availability, a beta-free current title and still-published beta scoring are each factual. None resolves current GA status by itself.

independent_ai_review.verdict: Pass for publication as AI-assisted beta drafts and an evidence-bounded inventory intake on the exact hashes above. No open material findings.
independent_ai_review.limitations: No purchase, seat search, scheduling, authenticated practice assessment, product/lab execution, or human technical review. The two-guide intake review does not establish exhaustive discovery, full source-validation or official provider endorsement.
